data.title: Why is Alphabet stock sliding today? By Investing.com
data.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Alphabet fell 4.2% in morning trading after Malaysia’s communications regulator filed two lawsuits against Google today seeking combined damages of roughly $146 million, alleging the company failed to adequately address harmful content — including online gambling, scams, and fraud — on its YouTube platform.
